title: East.Voice Dropped A New Single Track, "Mostanad"
htmlContent:
East.Voice is an International Rapper, Composer, and Songwriter. Voice's real name is Ramin Iz (Born 13 April 1992), known professionally as East.Voice. Born and raised in Mashhad.

East.Voice's hip-hop song, "Mostanad," is a soulful banger featuring clever wordplay and sampling. It's a powerful track with a unique sound that moves you. 

Give "Mostanad" a spin today! With a slick chorus and an addicting beat, it's easy to hear why this song takes the spotlight in hip-hop music. The lyrics are intense and emotion-filled, making it a memorable listen.
